scope: Targeted public primary-literature review; not exhaustive priority certification.
notation_verdict: Length scaling itself is not unique: explicit planar velocity/torque dual scaling is in RSS2011. The exact momentum symbol arrangement was not located, but follows directly from established dual scaling. No research contribution or priority established solely by notation.

publication_assessment.tutorial: An attributed explanatory technical note is a reasonable present publication form; no acceptance guarantee.
publication_assessment.research: No distinct completed new theoretical, numerical or independent experimental result has been established by this review.
publication_assessment.recommended_direction: Predict held-out translation and spin from separately documented material-pair inputs, measured geometry/inertia/state and uncertainty; compare established laws without validation-set coefficient fitting.
publication_assessment.algorithm_alternative: A specific new simultaneous-contact selection/solver law requires separate novelty analysis, feasibility/existence or convergence argument as appropriate, and accuracy/robustness evidence.

sources.difference: No claim their thermodynamically motivated law, local admissibility or integration scheme equals our endpoint acceptance gate.

limitations: Exact (p,L/ell) symbol pair not located; search absence cannot establish uniqueness.
Different coefficient conventions and constitutive laws must not be equated solely because they use en,et,mu.
All production-solver algorithms have not been audited for literature priority.
Existing24glass comparison is reproduction rather than independent held-out validation; spin reconstructed.
Global larger-scene accuracy baseline remains unqualified.
No publication or external submission performed.
